stable.notes: Hover is pills-only. The focused-session title card and the two circular buttons are gone from the reveal: the RUNNING, DONE, and WAITING pills open whatever is active, so a card naming one session and a second set of openers were redundancy. A single click on the figure still opens the focused session, and a double-click still opens the live list. Hover no longer changes the panel's layout at all. Finished entries are now clearable — every DONE row carries the same x the live list has; clearing removes that one entry, persists, and returns only if the session finishes again, and clearing the last entry closes the list. The ledger bar and its counts now sit on a soft blurred capsule so they stay readable over busy wallpaper; with Reduce Transparency the blur becomes a flat fill. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
